findings.rationale: The temporary filename is derived only from the source stem and process ID, then written with truncating std::fs::write and unconditionally removed by Drop. Reentrant materializations of the same Markdown path in one process therefore share a file, so one owner can overwrite or delete another owner's input; a preexisting same-named file can also be clobbered and removed.

Several result variants classify missing or wrongly typed sibling verdict fields as success: approval_check accepts any absent/non-signature-invalid status, format_check accepts absent/non-true changed, and lint and semantic_diff use is_none_or. A producer contract regression or malformed envelope can therefore be converted into a success-class verdict instead of failing closed.
